patch.value: Preview Linear field ownership and same-field conflicts
Compare an explicitly acknowledged Linear field snapshot with complete SDK local reads and current provider observations. Read-only preview; no cross-system atomic guarantee.

Disjoint edits are distinguished from same-field conflicts; unknown bases never imply safe overwrites; preview makes zero mutations and explicitly declines atomic cross-system guarantees; typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, actionable refusals, docs, seeded model tests and public tracker validation.

value.text: SDK surface audit: BulkItemMutation create/update rows accept PmClientFullMutationOptions and forward to the same sentinel-parsing lifecycle functions; no literal flag is declared. PmClient create/update likewise expose no literal control. commitImportedItem(document) is available for native import documents but does not preserve the existing bulk transaction/lifecycle contract and is not used to bypass it. Stdin literal WeakMap helpers exist internally but are not exported by the supported SDK runtime, so no deep import or loader bypass was added. Current workaround is explicit typed unrepresentable_value before any item writes for body/description dash and assignee/deadline clear tokens. Due dates are checked as literal calendar dates, preventing relative/control input. Legacy imports now use PmClient directly; atomic and legacy use one SDK option producer, and preview calls the same guarded buildItemPlan. Capture uses structured addJson (not annotation text parsing); export uses JSON GraphQL variables. Earlier final-head CI 40537038689 passed both release gates and both Node jobs, but that older-head success is not evidence for this new fix.
